name: Coding agent
job: An issue turned into a pull request by an agent, and questions about your code answered
intro: Hand an issue to an agent: Lemma in the cloud, or Claude Code or Codex on your Mac. It works in a branch of its own, opens the pull request, and fixes failing checks and review comments until a person merges it. Ask how the code works and get an answer that points at the lines.
does: One board of every agent's work across your repositories, with what needs you on top.
Each task's whole story: the transcript, the change, the pull request, every check and review round.
Questions about your code answered with path:line, and turned into a task in one press.

accounts.why: Your own GitHub sign-in: the agent checks out, pushes and opens pull requests as you, and Lemma hears about checks and reviews on them.

setup: Pick the repositories the agent may work in, and the commands it runs first in each.
Choose who runs by default: Lemma in the cloud, or Claude Code or Codex on your Mac.
Or look around with a sample board: a few tasks, a pull request's whole life, and two answered questions.
